caption_en: The implementing partner reports 3,416 farmers reached, 3,082 accessing improved services, monthly income rising 49 percent and 19 jobs created across seven Bauchi North LGAs.
caption_ha: Mashirin aiwatar ya ba da rahotar manoma 3,416, mutane 3,082 suna samu sabis mai inganci, kudin tafiye ya karu kashi 49 da ayyuka 19 a cikin LGA 7 na Bauchi North.
image_alt_en: Aerial view of a rural Bauchi community used as the ESTRRA programme source image.
image_alt_ha: Hoton aerial na wani al'umma a karkarirnin Bauchi da aka yi amfani da shi a matsayin hoton shirin ESTRRA.

caption_en: In Kurba, Giade, an 11/30kW rice mill and permanent structure are reported to have raised processing capacity from 10 to up to 30 bags per day.
caption_ha: A Kurba a Giade, an ba da rahotar cewa na'urar da aka bin dawa 11/30kW da tsari mai zama sun karfi iya sarawa daga 10 zuwa 30 bujiga a rana.
image_alt_en: Exterior of the Kurba rice milling hub in Giade.
image_alt_ha: Waiwar cibiyar da aka bin dawa na shinkafar Kurba a Giade.

caption_en: UNICEF reports that Toro was validated open-defecation-free in 2022 after community WASH action and a sanitation byelaw; continued maintenance and behaviour follow-up remain important.
caption_ha: UNICEF ya ba da rahotar cewa an tabbatar Toro a cikin 2022 a matsayin marasa zaɓa daƙawa bayan ayyuka na WASH da doka; kulawa da yadar da tauri suna ci gaba da muhimmanci.
image_alt_en: A person using a community hand-pump water point, used as a UNICEF WASH source image.
image_alt_ha: Mutumin da yake amfani da madauri mai hannu na al'umma, wanda aka yi amfani da shi a matsayin hoton WASH na UNICEF.

caption_en: The state reports rehabilitating or constructing 300 schools, deploying 3,000 teachers, providing 30,474 furniture units and mapping 21,000 non-formal Qur'anic schools; learning outcomes still require measurement.
caption_ha: Jihada tana ba da rahotar gyara ko gina makaranta 300, tafi da dalila 3,000, sanya kujewa 30,474 da yin taswirar makarantafi Qur'anic 21,000; nasara na ilmima har yanzu ana buƙatar aunawa.
image_alt_en: Portrait of an official speaking into a microphone, used as the source image for the education scorecard report.
image_alt_ha: Hoton ɗanƙo na gwamna yana magana da microphone, wanda aka yi amfani da shi a matsayin hoton rahotar kuskantin ilimi.

caption_en: UNICEF and the state report free maternal and child health services across more than 600 primary healthcare facilities; utilisation and health outcomes still require measurement.
caption_ha: UNICEF da jihada sun ba da rahotar ayyukan kiyaye lafiya ta iyali da yara cikin fiye da 600 na asibotin baƙin kafiya na farke; amfani da nasara na lafiya suna buƙatar aunawa.
image_alt_en: Seated pregnant woman, used as a generic maternal-health source image.
image_alt_ha: Mace mai ciki da jabari da zaɓi za ita, wanda aka yi amfani da shi a matsayin hotin kiyaye lafiya na iyali.
